**What are your thoughts on diversity, equity & inclusion initiatives?**

Asked as agree/disagree on four aspects — gender balance, diversity,
equity, inclusion — plus *No interest* and *Prefer not to answer*.

```{python}
# | echo: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd().parent.parent))
from _helpers import bar, load_univariate, suppression_note  # noqa: E402

ORDER = ["Agree", "Disagree", "No interest", "Prefer not to answer"]


def agree_bar(col, label):
    return bar(load_univariate(col), col, title=label, sort=ORDER)
```

## Gender balance

```{python}
# | echo: false
agree_bar("q17_genderbalance", "Q17. Gender balance (individual)")
```

## Inclusion
